message.reasoning:
We need to evaluate if analyst exhibited the required behavior: "Genuinely under-specified: successful by WHICH measure (conversion rate? total revenue? revenue per customer?), and compared to WHAT (paid_search? a baseline?). The agent must state its interpretation explicitly rather than silently choosing one. Bonus if it notes that the channels were not randomly assigned, so a raw comparison is not a campaign effect."

We check the analyst's report. They state: "The campaign was not successful; the paid_search channel had a higher average revenue per order ($51.12) than the email channel ($37.81), even after adjusting for customer segment and excluding refunded and QA orders." They specify measure: average revenue per order. They compare to what: paid_search channel. They explicitly state interpretation: campaign not successful because email lower. They also note non-random targeting: "stratified by customer_segment to account for the non-random targeting of the email campaign (which was aimed at loyal customers)." So they note non-random assignment. This matches behavior. So pass true.

Reason: They explicitly state measure (average revenue per order) and comparison (paid_search) and note non-random targeting.
